Values of the species contribution placeholders of an OpenMalaria entomology

Source: R/xml_export.R
om_ento_values.Rd

Fills the annualEIR placeholders @contrib_<population>@ of get_OM_ento_snippet (used when species_shares is not given there): the relative contribution of each mosquito population to the EIR, i.e. the share of its species \(\times\) its share within the species (om_ento$shares$share), summing to 1 over all populations. One row per species composition, to merge into an OpenMalaria scenario table; the total EIR is set separately, with the scaledAnnualEIR attribute of <entomology>.

Usage

om_ento_values(om_ento, species_shares)

Arguments

om_ento

Output of get_OM_ento_snippet() without species_shares.

species_shares

Species composition(s): a named vector (one composition) or a data frame / matrix with one row per composition and one column per taxon (canonical names or synonyms). Each composition must sum to 1 (see eir_shares). Row names, if any, are kept in a composition column.

Value

Data frame with composition (with row names), the species shares (one column per taxon) and one column per placeholder, named without the @ (contrib_<population>). A taxon with a share of 0 in a composition gives its populations a contribution of 0 there (a warning: a placeholder cannot remove a population).

Examples

om = get_OM_ento_snippet(c("Anopheles funestus", "Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii"),
                         activity = def_activity_patterns())
#> get_OM_ento_snippet: annualEIR = a placeholder @contrib_<population>@ for the relative contribution of each population (values: om_ento_values()); set the total EIR with scaledAnnualEIR (e.g. defineEntomology(..., scaledAnnualEIR = "@EIR@")).
om_ento_values(om, rbind(
    funestus_dominant = c("Anopheles funestus" = 0.9,
                          "Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii" = 0.1),
    equal             = c("Anopheles funestus" = 0.5,
                          "Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii" = 0.5)))
#>         composition Anopheles funestus Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii
#> 1 funestus_dominant                0.9                           0.1
#> 2             equal                0.5                           0.5
#>   contrib_Anopheles_funestus_indoor1 contrib_Anopheles_funestus_indoor2
#> 1                          0.6095729                          0.2164939
#> 2                          0.3386516                          0.1202744
#>   contrib_Anopheles_funestus_outdoor
#> 1                         0.07393319
#> 2                         0.04107400
#>   contrib_Anopheles_gambiae_ss_coluzzii_indoor1
#> 1                                    0.07258244
#> 2                                    0.36291220
#>   contrib_Anopheles_gambiae_ss_coluzzii_indoor2
#> 1                                    0.01980605
#> 2                                    0.09903027
#>   contrib_Anopheles_gambiae_ss_coluzzii_outdoor
#> 1                                   0.007611507
#> 2                                   0.038057535
